messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day
{ff 00 00 00}is today!{01 01 00}{07 04 00} Hey, that rhymed!
I'm a natural songwriter!
{07 00 00}Anyway, so the best song
gets to be the new town
tune.
{07 0d 00}It's pretty clear from that
little ditty I whipped up
that I have it in the bag.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {ff 00 00 03}Laulupäev
{ff 00 00 00}on täna!{01 01 00}{07 04 00} Hei, see riimus!
Olen sündinud lauluseadja!

saab uus linna
viis.
{07 0d 00}Sellest väikesest viisist,
mille kokku klopsisin, on
selge, et võit on mul käes.

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}, buddy,{01 00 00 14 00}
have I got a show-stopper
for you!
{07 00 00}Wanna hear it, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}Huh huh huh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Yahoo! {01 01 00}{07 0d 00}I guess

town tune chart!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hah hah haa!{01 00 00 0a 00} Juhhuu! {01 01 00}{07 0d 00}Vist
tähendab see, et olen linna
viiside edetabeli tipus!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Whoo-hoo!{00 01 00} {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day {ff 00 00 00}is
just the best, man! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0d 00}I'm
gonna sing my head off!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Juhhuu!{00 01 00} {ff 00 00 03}Laulupäev {ff 00 00 00}on
lihtsalt parim, semu! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0d 00}Ma
laulan pea otsast ära!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Singing at people is pretty
fun, huh? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}They always give
you the funniest looks!
{07 00 00}Oh, and, uh,{01 00 00 05 00} did you {07 0b 00}need
something, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Inimestele laulmine on
üsna lõbus, mis? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 03 00}Nad teevad
alati nii naljakaid nägusid!
{07 00 00}Oh, ja, ee,{01 00 00 05 00} kas sul {07 0b 00}oli
midagi vaja, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Singing is SOOO fun! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0e 00}Well,
not as fun as eating a
snack, but what is?
{07 0b 00}Oh, can I help you with
something?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Laulmine on NII lõbus! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0e 00}Noh,
mitte nii lõbus kui näksi
söömine, aga mis on?
{07 0b 00}Oh, kas saan sind millegagi
aidata?

messages.en:
